evidence: TiN films were deposited on the SiO2 layer using tetrakis (dimethylamino)titanium (TDMAT) as Ti precursor and plasmas of H2, N2, and NH3 as reactants. TDMAT was delivered from an external reservoir at 40°C and pulsed into the reactor using Ar carrier gas with the flow rate of 20 sccm. Ar purge gas flow rate was fixed at 100 sccm.
